title: MuSID-KD: Multigranularity Knowledge Distillation for Generative Recommendation with Semantic IDs
abstract: arXiv:2610.35218v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative recommendation with semantic IDs (SIDs) represents each item as a sequence of discrete tokens and autoregressively predicts the next item's SID. Despite strong recommendation performance, repeated decoding over multiple SID positions incurs substantial inference cost. Knowledge distillation transfers knowledge from a powerful generative teacher to a lightweight student, yet conventional objectives do not fully account for multi-token SID generation. We identify two limitations: item-level distribution alignment may not adequately preserve the teacher's ranking of candidate groups sharing SID prefixes, while uniform alignment across SID positions may affect final item ranking differently. We propose MuSID-KD, which combines Hierarchical Candidate Distribution Alignment (HCDA) and Ranking Impact Guided Levelwise Distillation (RIGD). translated_title: MuSID-KD：面向基于语义ID的生成式推荐的多粒度知识蒸馏
translated_abstract: 基于语义ID（SIDs）的生成式推荐将每个物品表示为一串离散token的序列，并以自回归方式预测下一个物品的SID。尽管其推荐性能表现优异，但在多个SID位置上的重复解码带来了可观的推理开销。知识蒸馏可以将强大的生成式教师模型的知识迁移给轻量级学生模型，然而传统的蒸馏目标未能充分考虑多token的SID生成过程。我们识别出两个局限性：物品级分布对齐可能无法充分保留教师模型对共享SID前缀的候选组的排序关系，而跨SID位置的统一对齐可能对最终物品排序产生不同的影响。我们提出MuSID-KD，该方法结合了层次化候选分布对齐（HCDA）和排序影响引导的逐层蒸馏（RIGD）。其中，HCDA根据共享的SID前缀对物品概率进行聚合，并对候选分布进行对齐。
tldr: 提出MuSID-KD框架，通过层次化候选分布对齐（HCDA）与排序影响引导的逐层蒸馏（RIGD）两种多粒度蒸馏策略，在降低基于语义ID的生成式推荐推理成本的同时，更好地保留教师模型的候选组排序知识。
en_tdlr: MuSID-KD introduces Hierarchical Candidate Distribution Alignment (HCDA) and Ranking Impact Guided Levelwise Distillation (RIGD) to achieve multigranularity knowledge distillation, reducing inference cost in semantic ID-based generative recommendation while preserving the teacher's ranking knowledge over candidate groups.
